The idea is approved and the script and scene list are written. I stopped there, as you asked. I did not make or play any audio.

## Idea (approved as my recommendation)
**"Typed it again."** The same support reply is typed out again and again, then all the copies fold into one saved card. The viewer should believe saved replies end the retyping, and know the feature is live.
- **Format:** 30 s cap, 16:9, confident energy, Justin as the voice.
- **Look:** editorial type on the off-white page, with deep green and an amber edge on the saved card.
- **Signature moment (scene 4):** the copies collapse into one card and "Saved replies" settles on it.
- **Other two concepts:** I considered "Inbox, calmer" and "The reply library" and dropped them. One needs inbox screens we don't have, and the other turns into a feature tour.

## Script (voice-over, about 24 s)
| Line | Scene | Beat | Energy | Voice-over | On screen |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 01 | S01 | Hook | 4 | You've typed this answer before. Probably today. | Typed that. Again. |
| 02 | S02 | Turn | 2 | Same question. Same reply. | The fifth time. |
| 03 | S03 | Proof | 2 | Write it once. Save it. | Once. |
| 04 | S03 | Proof | 2 | Next time a customer asks, it's right there. | Ready. |
| 05 | S03 | Proof | 2 | Pick it, check it, send it. | Your words. |
| 06 | S04 | Peak | 5 | Saved replies. | Saved replies |
| 07 | S04 | Offer | 4 | Your best answer, ready in every conversation. | Every thread. |
| 08 | S05 | Close | 4 | Live in your support inbox today. | Today. |

- **Hook:** I scored the chosen opening 7/8 on the four hook killers. The scores are my judgement. The two alternates scored 6/8 and are kept as ad variants.
- **Beat sheet:** the tool still flags Proof and Close as short. The scenes fill that with holds, and the film ends on a logo tail. The "no rest before the peak" flag is cleared.
- **Offer wording:** fixed as "Saved replies".

## Scene list (five scenes, type and drawn shapes only)
1. **S01 Typed that:** a reply types out, then the same words type again, faster.
2. **S02 The fifth time:** the copies stack and fade, and one word carries across to the next scene.
3. **S03 Once / Ready / Your words:** one clean reply, a bookmark mark draws on it, then the saved card rises.
4. **S04 Saved replies:** the copies fold into the card and the title settles, then "Every thread."
5. **S05 Today:** the logo lands and rests, then a short silent tail.

- **No real product UI exists.** Demo brand has no product and no discovery file, and the studio's rules ban invented screens. So the film is drawn type and shapes, with no inbox screen. A real inbox capture would need a real product.
